info.title: TurenOS HttpApi
info.description: Experimental HttpApi surface for selected instance routes.

get.description: Check whether the API server is ready to accept requests.
Resolve the requested location or the server default location.
Retrieve currently registered agents.

schema.description: When true, return only root sessions without a parent session.
Filter sessions by archived state when provided.
When lobby, include only internal TurenOS Lobby sessions for local recovery.
Filter sessions by whether they were last updated more than 48 hours ago.
Maximum number of sessions to return. Defaults to the newest 50 sessions.
Session order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.

anyOf.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response.

get.description: Retrieve sessions in the requested order. Items keep that order across pages; use cursor.next or cursor.previous to move through the ordered list.

post.description: Create a session at the requested location.

get.description: Search session metadata and durable replay events. Free text uses FTS5; filters include session, id, message, call, type, agent, model, tool, status, path, after, before, has:error, and is:session|event. Prefix a filter with - to negate it.
Retrieve foreground Session drains currently owned by this TurenOS process. Sessions absent from the result are inactive.

post.description: Snapshot active Session execution owned by this TurenOS process, resolve task-owned Sessions to their roots, and wait for every root cancellation cascade to settle. The response reports both successful and failed root cascades.

get.description: Retrieve a session by ID.
Retrieve the interactive PTY bound to this session, if one exists.

post.description: Create or return the single interactive PTY shared by the human and agent for this session.

delete.description: Terminate and remove the interactive PTY bound to this session.

put.description: Allow or prevent the session agent from interacting with the human terminal.

get.description: Retrieve the current declarative harness snapshot and proposals for a session.

post.description: Record a declarative harness proposal against a session snapshot version.
Change the lifecycle status of a declarative harness proposal.
Apply an accepted declarative harness proposal to create a new session snapshot.
Reject a declarative harness proposal without changing the active snapshot.
Reload the declarative harness state for a session and record the resulting snapshot.
Restore a prior declarative harness snapshot for a session.
Switch the agent used by subsequent provider turns.
Switch the model used by subsequent provider turns.
Durably admit one session input and schedule agent-loop execution unless resume is false.
Run one bounded shell command at the Session location and durably reconcile an exact retry by message ID.
Resolve one configured custom command into a durable prompt and reconcile exact retries by message ID.
Recover an interrupted durable turn without replaying it, report whether already-admitted work was scheduled, or schedule a safe advisory wake without joining the drain.

get.description: Retrieve the current durable goal, including loop usage and lifecycle state.

put.description: Create a durable goal, atomically admit its first objective prompt, then schedule agent-loop execution.

patch.description: Edit the current goal with an opaque identity and revision guard.

delete.description: Clear the guarded current goal and interrupt local execution after the clear is durable.

post.description: Persist a goal lifecycle transition. Activating schedules execution; other states interrupt after persistence.

get.description: List bounded task summaries newest first. Summary pages never include prompts or authority policy.
Retrieve one bounded durable subagent task detail owned by the selected Session tree.

post.description: Wait for local execution to stop before committing durable task cancellation. A timeout fails without reporting the task cancelled.

get.description: Retrieve the durable communication board shared by a Session and its subagents.
Retrieve the swarm room shared by a Session and its subagents: objective, members, lane claims, and head.
Retrieve room entries sequenced after `after`. The room's head is the compare-and-swap cursor for coordination writes.

post.description: Post a human-authored entry to a Session's swarm room. Agent members are notified through their durable input queue.
post.summary: Post a human message to the swarm room

post.description: Compact a session conversation.
Wait for a session agent loop to become idle.
Stage or move a reversible session boundary and optionally apply its file changes.

get.description: Retrieve the active context messages for a session (all messages after the last compaction).
Retrieve durable admitted inputs that have not yet been promoted into the projected transcript.
Retrieve one admitted, promoted, or cancelled input by its stable message ID.
List admitted, promoted, and cancelled inputs in admission order.
Read one finite page of public durable Session events after an exclusive aggregate sequence. Newly committed events may appear on later pages.

Read durable root-session events together with linked task aggregate events in deterministic timestamp and aggregate order. Unlike public session history, this includes legacy creation/message records for debugging.
get.summary: Read the complete session debug stream

get.description: Replay durable events after an aggregate sequence, then continue with new durable events.

post.description: Wait for owned subagent execution to stop before committing durable cancellation, then interrupt active execution owned by this TurenOS process. A timeout fails without reporting still-running tasks cancelled.

get.description: Retrieve one projected message owned by the Session.

schema.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, the endpoint returns its default page size.
Message order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.

anyOf.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response. Do not combine with order.

schema.description: When true, oversized tool result bodies are replaced with a `truncated` marker; fetch the full row via the single-message endpoint. When omitted, rows are returned in full.

get.description: Retrieve projected messages for a session. Items keep the requested order across pages; use cursor.next or cursor.previous to move through the ordered timeline.
Retrieve pending permission requests for a location.
Retrieve saved permissions, optionally filtered by project.

delete.description: Remove a saved permission by ID.

post.description: Evaluate and, when approval is required, create a permission request for a session.

get.description: Retrieve pending permission requests owned by a session.
Retrieve a pending permission request owned by a session.

post.description: Respond to a pending permission request owned by a session.

get.description: Serve one file relative to the requested location.
List direct children of one directory relative to the requested location.
Find recursively ranked filesystem entries relative to the requested location.
Retrieve currently registered commands.
Subscribe to native event payloads for the server.
List PTY sessions for a location, including exited sessions retained until removal.

post.description: Create a pseudo-terminal session for a location.

get.description: Get one PTY session, including its exit code once exited.

put.description: Update the title or viewport size of one PTY session.

delete.description: Terminate and remove one PTY session.

post.description: Create a short-lived single-use ticket for opening a PTY WebSocket connection.

get.description: Establish a WebSocket connection streaming PTY output and accepting terminal input.
Retrieve pending question requests for a location.
Retrieve pending question requests owned by a session.

post.description: Answer a pending question request owned by a session.
Reject a pending question request owned by a session.

post.summary: Create or update a memory wing
Create or update a memory room

post.description: Create and activate a recurring prompt loop. When no location is selected, it runs in the TurenOS global data directory.

get.description: List recurring prompt loops configured for a location.
Retrieve one recurring prompt loop by ID.

patch.description: Edit a loop's prompt, schedule, or model selection.

delete.description: Delete a loop and prevent future scheduled runs.

post.description: Pause future scheduled runs of a loop.
Resume future scheduled runs of a paused loop.
Start an immediate manual run of a loop.

get.description: List execution history for a loop.
Retrieve one run from a loop's execution history.

post.description: Cancel a pending or running loop execution.

get.description: List cached normalized security advisories newest first.
List cached CISA KEV items newest first.
List cached security news newest first.
Daily advisory counts over a trailing window.
List the effective intel feed list: built-in defaults plus per-user overrides.

post.description: Add a custom intel feed. The id is derived from the name when omitted.

patch.description: Enable, disable, or edit an intel feed. Only provided fields change.

post.description: Discard per-user feed overrides and restore the built-in defaults.

get.description: Last poll times and per-feed status.

post.description: Force an immediate feed poll (overlap-guarded, staleness ignored) and return the fresh status.

allOf.description: Ordered model-visible text. When present, these parts are authoritative over aggregate prompt text; ignored parts stay durable but are omitted from model and compaction context.
Latest committed aggregate sequence, or -1 when the session has no durable events.

status.description: Current status of the task: pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled

priority.description: Priority level of the task: high, medium, low

answers.description: User answers in order of questions (each answer is an array of selected labels)

tags.name: loops
tags.description: Location-scoped recurring prompt loops and run history.

tags.name: intel
tags.description: Cached security intelligence (zero-config reads, per-user feed settings).
